name: AEM electrolysis
principle: An anion exchange membrane carries hydroxide ions between electrodes in a dilute alkaline or pure-water environment. It aims to combine the cheap, platinum-free materials of alkaline electrolysis with the compact, pressurised design of PEM. DOE gives 50 to 80 °C operation.

process_steps.name: AEM stacks
equipment: many AEM stacks around a common balance of plant

source.note: DOE Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Technologies Office, Hydrogen Production: Electrolysis

performance.basis: Enapter AEM Nexus 1000, all utilities inside battery limits, 99.5% purity configuration
Enapter AEM Nexus 1000 (202 Nm3/h) at 933 kW nominal, up to 31 barg outlet

advantages: No platinum-group metals needed in principle
Delivers pressurised hydrogen (up to 31 barg on Nexus 1000)
